criteria.requirement: Extend RepositoryIni with keyword-only section='settings' and interpolation=True. Each instance selects its own nonempty section; interpolation=False reads literal % sequences such as URL percent escapes, while True preserves existing ConfigParser interpolation. Preserve DEFAULT inheritance, case-insensitive option lookup, encoding, Config environment precedence and default behavior. Validate option types; do not globally escape percent signs or mutate the class SECTION for other instances.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。
